AdditionalService.name: Additional Service
AdditionalService.definition: Service in addition to the main service.

TransactionCategory.name: Transaction Category
TransactionCategory.definition: Category code conform to ISO 18245, related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction.

SaleReconciliationIdentification.name: Sale Reconciliation Identification
SaleReconciliationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the sales reconciliation period between the acceptor and the acquirer. This identification might be linked to the identification of the settlement for further verification by the merchant.

SequenceNumberRange.name: Sequence Number Range
SequenceNumberRange.definition: Range of sequence numbers on which the globalisation applies.

TransactionDateRange.name: Transaction Date Range
TransactionDateRange.definition: Date range on which the globalisation applies.
